crossRefs.note: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.
The Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is…

translations.web: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
